newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - South Bound Brook, N.J..

text.p: in the County of Somerset, New Jersey

SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Borough Treasure of the Borough of South Bound Brook, in the County of Somerset, New Jersey (the Borough''), at the Borough Hall, 12 Main Street, South Bound Brook, New Jersey 08880 on

at 11:00 o'clock A.M. at which time they will be publicly opened and announced, for the purchase of the Borough's $984,000 General Improvement Bonds and $58,000 Assessment Bonds, each issue dated July 1, 1997 (individually, the General Improvement Bonds'' or the Assessment Bonds''; collectively, the Bonds''). The Bonds comprise two issues of bonds payable on July 1 in each year (without the right of prior redemption) as follows:
$ 55,000 in each of the years 1998 and 1999,
$110,000 in each of the years 2000 and 2001,
$110,000 in each of the years 2003 to 2006,
$15,000 in each of the years 1999 to 2001,
The combined maturity schedule for the Bonds is as follows:
Year Maturing Year Maturing Year Maturing

The Bonds shall be issued in registered form by means of a book-entry system with no physical distribution of bond certificates made to the public. One bond certificate for each maturity of each issue will be issued to The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York (DTC'') and immobilized in its custody. The book-entry system will evidence
ownership of the Bonds in the principal amount of $1,000 or any multiple thereof, with transfers of ownership effected

on the records of DTC and its participants pursuant to and procedures established by DTCand its participants. This Summary Notice of Sale is intended only as a brief summary of the Notice of Sale to be made available to interested persons (the

e of Sale is hereby incorporated herein by this reference thereto. The Notice of Sale and Proposal for Bonds should be reviewed by potential bidders for additional terms and conditions of the sale of the Bonds prior to bidding on the Bonds. The Bonds will bear interest from their date at a single rate of interest in a multiple of 1/8th or 1/20th of 1% per annum specified by the successful bidder payable on each January 1 and July 1, commencing January 1, 1998, in each year until maturity. The purchase price specified must not be less than $1,042,000 nor more than $1,043,000. Bidders must at the time of making their bids deposit a certified, cashier's or treasurer's check in the amount of $20,840 drawn upon a bank or trust company to the order of the Borough. The Bonds will be sold to the bidder specifying the lowest rate of interest in accordance with the terms set forth in the Notice of Sale. The Borough will furnish the Bonds and the approving legal opinion of Rogut, McCarthy & Bhend, A Professional Corporation, Cranford, New Jersey, Bond Counsel. The Bonds will be designated as

obligations'' for purposes of Section 265(b) (3) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended. Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, the Notice of Sale and the Proposal for Bonds are available by contacting the undersigned Borough Treasurer at the Borough Hall, 12 Main Street, South Bound Brook, New Jersey 08880 (telephone (908) 356-0258). By order of the the Borough Council of the Borough of South Bound Brook, in the County of Somerset, New Jersey.
